parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing record is strongly protective: constitutional gender-identity protection, statutory hate-crime and discrimination coverage including gender expression, legal recognition without surgery, protected bathroom access, no criminalisation, and survey victimisation at the regional low end with 84% viewing the country as good for LGBT people. Court awarded damages against prison authorities for trans inmates — institutions working FOR trans people. Deductions: documented institutional lag in corrections (misgendering, clothing/healthcare gaps), low reporting of violence despite reforms, elevated harassment/online hatred, and a pending border case showing asylum detainees face removal without individualised assessment — relevant if a visitor is detained, though scoped to asylum seekers. Custody placement, while imperfect, now allows transfer to the female section with individual cells. Friction and edge-case gaps, not unremedied universal exposure or organised targeting.
